newsitem.title: INDIA: India March castor gains, but export demand falls.
newsitem.headline: India March castor gains, but export demand falls.

text.p: Indian castorseed March delivery prices rose to 1,137/1,138 rupees from 1,135/1,136 on stray speculative buying despite low export demand, dealers said.
The rise was aided by lower arrivals at producing centres. Castorseed arrivals in the Gujarat region fell on Friday to 7-8,000 bags (75 kg each) against 11-12,000 the previous day.

Groundnut oil eased to 343/344 rupees per 10 kg from 346/347 rupees on sluggish physical buying after reports of fresh arrivals of 2,500 tonnes of imported palm oil at Bombay port. Groundnut oil arrivals also remained higher at 140/150 tonnes.
In Rajkot spot oil was steady at 529/530 rupees per 15 kg.
